Name: Crab Pot Fish Rerandomized
Author: WhyBother11
Description:
Vanilla crab pot fish randomization is... not great. In short, it checks crab pot fish sequentially and when it determines that current fish is caught, it completely skips others, favoring fish that happens to be checked first. This mod improves this logic to check other crab pot fish as well, hopefully making its randomization better.

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
This mod takes into account all crab pot fish and should generally be compatible with most mods.
May be incompatible with mods that modify crab pot behavior. If you have any errors after adding this mod, please report them.
